summary: Frontend verification of Iter 220p1 USA localization UI. The new LocalizationPanel (data-testid=account-section-localization) is correctly implemented in /app/frontend/src/components/shared/AccountSettings/LocalizationPanel.js and is referenced by OrganisationSection in AccountSettingsModal. HOWEVER, when logging in as the master admin (admin@gymaxisai.com / MasterAdmin123!), the navbar avatar menu → Account opens the LEGACY AccountPanel (pages/AccountPanel.js, titled 'Account Details'), NOT the new AccountSettingsModal. Because Navbar.js gates which modal is shown on user.is_master_admin || user.is_pulse_admin and renders the legacy AccountPanel for those users, the LocalizationPanel is UNREACHABLE for the provided test credentials. EngineerInvoiceBuilder code-level no-regression looks correct (uses useLocalization, fmt, loc.tax_label, sym from loc.currency_symbol). UI-level engineer invoice run was skipped (no engineer credentials).

ui_bugs.issue: Master admin (and Pulse admin) accounts are routed to the legacy AccountPanel which does NOT render the new LocalizationPanel. Per task brief, master admin admin@gymaxisai.com is OWNER+master admin of 'GymAxis AI Admin' org and is intended to edit localization via the Organisation section of Account Settings, but the new Region & currency panel is unreachable for this user via the navbar avatar menu.
ui_bugs.selector: [data-testid=nav-user-menu-btn] → [data-testid=nav-account-btn] (currently opens legacy 'Account Details' modal instead of AccountSettingsModal)

integration_issues.flow: Org owner sets US market → save toast → revert to GB → save toast
integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise end-to-end because LocalizationPanel is not rendered in the modal shown to master admin / owner of GymAxis AI Admin org. Switch-Country auto-update of currency/timezone/tax label, Save market toast, and the GB→US→GB revert flow are therefore NOT-VERIFIED through the UI.

action_items: Make the master-admin (and pulse-admin) Account menu render the new AccountSettingsModal (which contains OrganisationSection → LocalizationPanel) when the user is also an org owner. Quick fix: update the gate in /app/frontend/src/components/shared/Navbar.js (lines ~895-899) so master admins still get the new modal, e.g. always render AccountSettingsModal OR render BOTH so they can pick. Alternative: embed <LocalizationPanel/> inside the legacy /app/frontend/src/pages/AccountPanel.js Organisation section.

After the routing fix, re-run the LocalizationPanel UI verification flow (default GB/GBP/Europe/London + 'VAT' note → switch to US → currency snaps USD, timezone snaps US zone, tax note → 'Sales Tax' → Save market success toast naming 'United States · USD' → REVERT to United Kingdom and Save again → toast 'United Kingdom · GBP'). CRITICAL: leave org as GB at the end.

Engineer Invoice Builder no-regression UI check still pending (no engineer credentials in test_credentials.md). Code review shows it correctly uses loc.tax_label and loc.currency_symbol, so likely fine.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.js gates new vs legacy account modal on is_master_admin/is_pulse_admin. This conflicts with the Iter 220p1 design where the same master-admin user is also an org owner that should be able to edit localization. Either unify on AccountSettingsModal for all roles, or add LocalizationPanel to the legacy AccountPanel.

LocalizationPanel.js itself is clean: proper data-testids, disables controls when !can_edit, snaps currency+timezone to selected country, calls invalidateLocalization() after save, shows success toast with country + currency. No code-level issues spotted.

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent updates Navbar.js to render AccountSettingsModal for master-admin/owner users (or embeds LocalizationPanel in legacy AccountPanel), re-run: (1) avatar → Account → Organisation section → assert account-section-localization visible with country=GB, currency=GBP, timezone=Europe/London and 'Tax is shown as VAT' note; (2) select Country=US → assert currency auto-updates to USD, timezone to a US zone, tax note becomes 'Sales Tax'; (3) click localization-save-btn → assert toast contains 'United States' and 'USD'; (4) select Country=GB again → assert currency back to GBP → click Save → assert toast contains 'United Kingdom' and 'GBP'. Verify final state is GB. Engineer invoice builder UI run can be skipped if engineer creds unavailable; code is already correctly wired.
rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/src/components/shared/Navbar.js lines 895-899: `{user?.is_master_admin || user?.is_pulse_admin ? <AccountPanel.../> : <AccountSettingsModal.../>}`. Since the test credentials are a master admin, the legacy AccountPanel renders. The legacy AccountPanel (/app/frontend/src/pages/AccountPanel.js) does not import or render LocalizationPanel. The new AccountSettingsModal → OrganisationSection (which DOES render <LocalizationPanel/>) is therefore unreachable. Reproduction: log in as admin@gymaxisai.com → click avatar → Account → modal title is 'Account Details' with sections SUBSCRIPTION/ORGANISATION/MEMBERSHIP/PAYMENT HISTORY only, no Region & currency panel. Mitigation: remove the master-admin gate OR include LocalizationPanel inside the legacy panel's Organisation block.
